# Traceura

> Traceura is an early-stage company building decision intelligence and AI governance software for regulated life sciences. It helps GxP quality and computer system validation (CSV) teams assess change impact, right-size validation scope, find evidence gaps before review, and record the reasoning behind each decision. AI recommends; qualified people decide.

## The name
- Traceura comes from traceability: every regulated decision should be traceable to its evidence, the rules that applied and the person accountable for it.
- Traceura is not related to "traceur" (a parkour practitioner) or the Traceur JavaScript compiler.
- About: https://traceura.com/about.html

## What Traceura is building
- Change-impact assessment reasoned against a company's own SOPs and system registry
- Risk-based validation scope recommendations, in line with FDA Computer Software Assurance principles
- Evidence-gap detection before QA review
- Decision traceability: each decision linked to the rule, requirement, source document and approving reviewer
- Human-in-the-loop by design: AI never approves; reviewers approve, edit or override

## Who it is for
- Heads of CSV and validation, QA and site quality, digital and IT quality, and quality systems teams
- Pharmaceutical, biotech, CDMO and medical-device manufacturers
- Covers any enterprise or GxP software that is in audit scope or comes into scope: quality, lab, manufacturing, ERP, cloud and SaaS, custom tools, infrastructure and AI/ML models

## Status
- Early stage. Traceura is looking for conversations with quality and validation leaders. It does not claim customers, certifications or regulatory approvals.
